text:
Zoe: quick shoutout to Rafael & Priya for patching the promo banner bug during the walkthrough  saved the slide deck and the Q&A. :tada:
Rafael: yeah big team effort  Priya pushed the hotfix, Jonah reverted the bad migration, Sam patched CSS.
Priya: shoutout to Mina for re-exporting the mockups on 2min notice. design rescue! :sparkles:
Mina: happy to help  great debugging by Rafael. also added a tiny "saved by design" badge in the assets folder.
build-bot: deploy-check: promo-banner-hotfix passed CI, canary healthy. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: incident-tag: promo-banner-regen | resolved by Rafael, Priya, Jonah | no customer impact. :thumbsup:
Sam: tiny logistics idea  can we start a micro-kudos ritual? low friction tokens people can give when someone saves the day.
Zoe: yes please. options: stickers, sticky notes, or token coins? react with :label: for stickers, :page_facing_up: sticky notes, :coin: coins
Jonah: :label: stickers. they travel well and look silly on laptops.
Mina: :page_facing_up: sticky notes are nice cause you can scribble a line.
Rafael: :coin: coins feel official but maybe noisy.
Priya: stickers + a tiny date spot. I can print 40 tomorrow.
Sam: I can fund printing. Also proposing a tiny whiteboard column "micro-kudos" where people stick them next to names.
Zoe: love it. will include a 1-line in the Friday digest: "micro-win: Rafael/Priya/Jonah/Sam patched promo banner during client walkthrough"
Rafael: GIF idea for digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-3o6ZsY5aX6k8E
Mina: volunteers to stick the first batch after lunch? 2 minutes.
Jonah: in.
Sam: in too. Also who wants the first sticker legend? we should have 3 designs: "Demo Saver", "Design Rescue", "Patch Ninja"
Priya: I'll mockup those tonight.
Zoe: also posting a tiny kudos channel thread: please drop 1-line of thanks when you hand a sticker. keeps the signal in Slack.
Priya: tiny extra  I'm bringing bagels tomorrow labeled "Kudos Fuel". stickers go on the board when you take one.
Rafael: perfect. thanks everyone  feels good to celebrate quick wins. :coffee: :sparkles:
Zoe: closing note  can we add the promo-banner runbook step that Jonah used to the docs? saves future time.
Jonah: will do and tag Rafael for review.
Zoe: thanks team  micro rituals = big moral wins. :heart:
